rationale: Piecewise-linear IEEE-style Volt-VAR curve: inject reactive power below 0.98 pu and absorb above 1.02 pu. Breakpoints sized so linear interpolation at t_low (0.94 pu) and t_high (1.07 pu) yields the minimum Q commands that bring corrected voltages to the 0.95–1.05 pu band, with zero Q at nominal.
